repairs.quote: Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of 5 rockets that deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage. Max Damage: (90/135/180/225/270 + (103% Ability Power)) magic damage. Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion. Enemies hit by multiple rockets take (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first. Minions instead take (30/45/60/75/90 + (36% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first
